Term2: Peritoneal dialysis peritonitis, cefazolin and gentamicin
Text:
# CEFAZOLIN AND GENTAMICIN

# FOR PERITONITIS ASSOCIATED WITH PERITONEAL DIALYSIS

Cefazolin 15 mg/kg PD q24h and gentamicin 0.6 mg/kg PD q24h in 2000 mL 2.5% dextrose diaslyate solution.

[Click Here to order WITH heparin](psjizid-pd-cefaz-1gm-q24h-gent-q24h-hep)

If Heparin is contraindicated then:

[Click Here to order WITHOUT heparin](psjizid-pd-cefaz-1gm-q24h-gent-q24h)
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU PD CEFAZOLIN 15MG/KG Q24H AND GENT 0.6MG/KG Q24H
